createTable.remarks: A Retailer whose Feeds are ingested, keyed by the same id as in HowiBuy

column.name: id
column.remarks: The primary key, the id of the Retailer's service account in the IDM

column.name: name
column.remarks: The name

createTable.remarks: One of a Retailer's e-shops, serving one country with its own assortment and prices

column.name: id
column.remarks: The primary key, a short stable code chosen by us, identical in HowiBuy, e.g. 'rimi-lt'

column.name: retailer_id
column.remarks: The Retailer owning this Catalogue

column.name: country
column.remarks: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the country served, e.g. 'LT'

column.name: primary_language
column.remarks: ISO 639-1 code of the language every listed product must be named in, e.g. 'lt'

column.name: accepted_languages
column.remarks: ISO 639-1 codes of the languages the products may be named in, the primary one among them

column.name: adapter
column.remarks: The name of the adapter that reads the Feeds

column.name: active
column.remarks: Whether Feeds are accepted for this Catalogue

createTable.remarks: A file a Retailer sent, stored once whatever the number of Catalogues it is for

column.name: id
column.remarks: The primary key

column.name: retailer_id
column.remarks: The Retailer that sent the Feed

column.name: feed_type
column.remarks: SNAPSHOT, DELTA or DELETION

column.name: received_at
column.remarks: When the Feed was stored

column.name: file_path
column.remarks: Where the gzip-compressed Feed is stored, relative to the directory of the feed store

column.name: file_size
column.remarks: The size of the Feed as received, before compression, in bytes

column.name: file_sha256
column.remarks: The SHA-256 of the Feed as received, before compression, in lowercase hex

createTable.remarks: The processing of one Feed for one Catalogue

column.name: id
column.remarks: The primary key

column.name: feed_id
column.remarks: The Feed the run processes, which tells its type, its receipt and its file

column.name: catalogue_id
column.remarks: The Catalogue the Feed is processed for

column.name: status
column.remarks: RECEIVED, PROCESSING, HELD, DONE, FAILED or DISCARDED

column.name: adapter
column.remarks: The adapter that parses the Feed; null until processing starts

column.name: adapter_version
column.remarks: The version of the adapter; null until processing starts

column.name: started_at
column.remarks: When processing started; null until then

column.name: finished_at
column.remarks: When processing finished; null until then

column.name: count_total
column.remarks: The records read from the Feed; the counts are null until processing finishes

column.name: count_valid
column.remarks: The records that passed validation

column.name: count_rejected
column.remarks: The records rejected, listed in IN_INGESTION_REJECT

column.name: count_added
column.remarks: The records new to the Catalogue

column.name: count_changed
column.remarks: The records that changed a Retailer Product or its Listing

column.name: count_unchanged
column.remarks: The records that changed nothing

column.name: count_missing
column.remarks: The active Listings of the Catalogue that a Snapshot did not carry, which it takes off sale

column.name: count_deactivated
column.remarks: The Listings taken off sale

column.name: error
column.remarks: Why the run failed; null otherwise

column.name: replay_of_run_id
column.remarks: The run whose stored Feed this run processes again; null if this run received its Feed itself

createTable.remarks: A record of a Feed that was not applied, and why

column.name: ingestion_run_id
column.remarks: The Ingestion Run that read the record

column.name: position
column.remarks: Where the record is in the Feed, counting the records from 1

column.name: product_key
column.remarks: The product key of the record; null if it could not be read

column.name: reason
column.remarks: Why the record was rejected

createTable.remarks: A physical product as the Retailer identifies it, the same in every Catalogue of the Retailer

column.name: id
column.remarks: The primary key, assigned by the Ingestion; HowiBuy assigns its own

column.name: retailer_id
column.remarks: The Retailer of the product; part of the external key

column.name: product_key
column.remarks: The Retailer's own id of the product; part of the external key

column.name: characteristics
column.remarks: The language-neutral characteristics of the product, a JSON object of strings

column.name: tags
column.remarks: The language-neutral tags of the product

column.name: input_hash
column.remarks: The classification input hash over the names, characteristics and tags, in lowercase hex

column.name: change_sequence
column.remarks: The value of IN_CHANGE_SEQUENCE taken when the product or one of its Listings last changed visibly

column.name: removed
column.remarks: Whether the product is a tombstone, left without Listings

column.name: removed_at
column.remarks: When the product became a tombstone, which it is purged a while after; null while it is not one

createTable.remarks: The name of a Retailer Product in one language

column.name: retailer_product_id
column.remarks: The product this name belongs to; part of the primary key

column.name: lang
column.remarks: ISO 639-1 language code, e.g. 'en', 'el'; part of the primary key

column.name: name
column.remarks: The name

createTable.remarks: A Retailer Product on sale in one Catalogue, at that Catalogue's price

column.name: retailer_product_id
column.remarks: The product on sale; part of the primary key

column.name: catalogue_id
column.remarks: The Catalogue it is on sale in; part of the primary key

column.name: price
column.remarks: The price in the Catalogue

column.name: currency
column.remarks: ISO 4217 code of the currency of the price, e.g. 'EUR'

column.name: active
column.remarks: Whether the Listing is in its Catalogue's latest Feeds; an inactive one is never offered as an Alternative

column.name: last_seen_at
column.remarks: When a Feed of the Catalogue last carried the Listing

column.name: last_seen_run_id
column.remarks: The Ingestion Run of the Feed that last carried the Listing
